open_problem_before.title: All-degree Gaussian structure and valid vanishing transfers
open_problem_before.scope: Classify exceptional balanced-support pure-null coefficient loci within precisely stated architectures, separating GMC-safe Gaussian conjugacies from persistent mixed failures; identify hypotheses controlling incomparable radial degrees, independently audit reusable analytic period/seed transfers, and prove valid lower-order transfers or whole-architecture obstructions preserving dimension, differential order, harmonicity and rank-one/separability. GMCDEGREEBARRIER20261115 excludes degree-independent finite pure tests and degree-free mixed constants; GMCSUPPORT20261115 closes support-universal and generic nullity. Neither closes the specialized exceptional locus. General GMC is already false in dimension3 from degree4; do not seek a false unrestricted theorem. FWT1/PSMT1 retain one radial variable; G3AFFINEW20261114 is a complete all-degree architecture; GWNONSING20261114 remains independently unreviewed analytically. DVG1/DVG4/SIC2C4 retain exact operator-order and separability boundaries. User priority is structural progress across degrees and dimensions; further fixed-cubic numeric refinements are secondary. The qualitative cubic theorem remains internally closed; its least-prefix and assurance questions remain separately open. MVLOGCURVE20261115 supplies an internal all-degree logarithmic curve-period criterion: arbitrary rational phase and finitely many moving punctures on P1,full logarithmic form with bounded residues and decaying normalization; also arbitrary-genus finite covers when both phase and form descend. The seed-submodule bridge passes its scope audit with local analytic rather than global rational extension. Analytic action-filtration/growth remains independently unreviewed. Next seek exact Gaussian eliminations meeting this criterion; no new GMC family or cubic numeric change is claimed. GWSQUAREFREE20261115 now applies the logarithmic criterion to a new Gaussian architecture in every degree: P=W*(a(Z)+b(Z)*T)+G(Z,T) has no pure-null members when b is nonconstant squarefree,with arbitrary a,G. All b(0)/a(0) faces,including the removed formal g0 component,are covered. The remaining linear-T boundary is b constant or repeated-root;both have safe pure-null examples and cannot be excluded wholesale. The analytic dependency remains internally written and independently unreviewed;numeric cubic bounds are unchanged. MVRESOLVENT20261115 proves polynomiality of E exp(tr)/(1-tH) only for H=r=0,using decaying moving residues for nonconstant H and retained univariate nullity for constant H. GMCNEUTRALFACE20261115 completely classifies arbitrary-degree weakly one-sided angular supports with neutral part ZW H(T)+r(T):eventual pure vanishing iff the neutral face vanishes,with sharp mixed cutoff m>deg Q. In particular the entire h(0,T)=0 W-linear branch is closed:Z^2 divides h and Z divides G are necessary and sufficient. Do not reopen those completed arbitrary-degree subcases. Remaining linear-T constant/repeated-root branches require h(0,T) nonzero;higher neutral radial degree and genuinely mixed-sign supports remain. Analytic review and operator-transfer boundaries are unchanged.
